Other maps of this territory

This small index sits alongside larger, differently organized resources: HIPR2 groups image-processing operators; The Nature of Code teaches computational systems; and The Algorithmic Beauty of Plants develops formal approaches to plant modeling.

The previews are original educational code, not reproductions of artists’ works. People links reuse the project’s contribution records; “source recheck pending” remains visible for imported records. Computational roles are an editorial navigation aid, not mutually exclusive scientific categories.
